Says whether [GraphicsOrderIndependentTransparency](GraphicsOrderIndependentTransparency) can be used on the graphics driver in use. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such function. It needs a pass with four color attachments of half floats that can be blended, which every driver that BlitzLLVM draws 3D with has.
@returns 1 if order-independent transparency can be turned on, else 0.
